# Cadrelia 0.1.0: first test version
Thanks for trying Cadrelia! This is an early test version: things may change or break.
- Add Ethereum, Tezos or Bitcoin wallets and see your collection in the Library. - Hang your artworks on the desktop, live or as still images, with Fit, Fill or Mat framing. - Screen saver, labels, and exhibitions, frames and label styles for collectors.
Something wrong or confusing? **Send Feedback…** in the menu bar.
